# Q-050 E18: a fee giving the position of an arrival in a transaction the same
# import refused.
#
# The first transaction brings 2,720.00 USD in and takes a 0.72 USD fee out
# giving no cost basis, and is refused for it (E10). Its splits are destroyed
# with it, so the second transaction's fee, giving the arrival's position, has
# no guid to draw on and is refused, saying transaction 0 was not imported.
# The book is left holding no cost basis.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_split_draws_on_a_cost_basis_by_its_position_in_the_file.py.
2026-08-13 * "Received money, less the transfer fee"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Wise USD 2720.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "380000/272000"
		value: "3800.00"
	Assets:Wise USD -0.72 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "101/72"
		value: "-1.01"
	Income:Sales -3800.00 CAD
	Expenses:Bank charges 1.01 CAD

2026-08-14 * "A second transfer fee"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Bank charges 1.01 CAD
	Assets:Wise USD -0.72 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "101/72"
		value: "-1.01"
		cost_basis_split_guid: $transactions_to_import[0].splits[0].guid$
